svg.aria-label: Flow map of the R1 cascade on seed 0 of the synthetic example: 3,000 TEST flows go through binary, router and gate to ATTACK or BENIGN, each band split into true attacks and true benign flows. The entry classifier sends 2,125 flows to BENIGN, 352 of them attacks; the router flags 743, 687 of them attacks, and passes 132 to the gate, 73 of them attacks; the gate flags 2 benign flows and misses all 73.

svg.text: The gate catches 0 of the 73 attacks the router passes to it. The report's stage table says the same: removing the gate costs nothing.
